hints.title: Frequency Prefix Accumulation
hints.text: Process array elements from right to left, querying how many smaller elements have already been encountered.

hints.title: Coordinate Compression for Sparse Values
hints.text: Sort unique array values and map each element to its zero-based or one-based rank for compact frequency tree indexing.

hints.title: Binary Indexed Tree Prefix Query
hints.text: Map values to compressed ranks 1 to M. Traverse nums in reverse order: query sum in Fenwick tree for rank - 1, record as answer for this index, then update Fenwick tree at rank by +1.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: U: number of unique values in nums
complexity.notes: Optimal Fenwick tree frequency counting on coordinate-compressed ranks.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning elements to the right for each index takes quadratic O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Binary Indexed Tree provides logarithmic prefix sum queries and point updates.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use coordinate compression to handle negative and large values cleanly.
